card.name: The word daily, esp. in newspaper names
card.fires_on: The word "daily" (or the piece "Daily"/"dailym") in newspaper and web-address names, and also at the start of dosing phrases such as "Daily dose" or "daily doses".

modes.label: Newspaper names
modes.description: "Daily" as part of a paper's name or web address in citations.
modes.example: Megan. ”Pupils at scandal hit school post sexy Facebook shot of principal over hallways.” The<< Daily>> Mail. 5 December 20

modes.label: Daily in dosing text
modes.description: "Daily" opening or inside a drug-label phrase about doses, administration or living activities.
modes.example: There is limited experience with<< daily>> doses greater than 1,00

card.writes: It pushes toward words like chart, dose and digest, and pushes down day, days and daily, so it avoids repeating the idea of day.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "daily", whether in a newspaper title like Daily Mail or in a phrase like daily dose.
